task: Identification and resolution of each contradiction in the API specification.

criteria.text: Identifies that statements 1 and 2 contradict: 201 Created vs 200 OK for POST /users.
Identifies that 3 and 4 contradict: 409 Conflict vs silently merging duplicate emails.
Identifies that 5 and 6 contradict: every endpoint requires a Bearer token vs POST /users being public registration.
Identifies that 7 and 8 contradict: server-assigned auto-increment integer IDs vs client-generated UUIDs in the body.

Proposes a resolution for each, with a reason. For example: 201 with a Location header; 409 (a silent merge enables account takeover and data leakage); exempt POST /users from authentication explicitly; server-generated IDs (a single type, never client-supplied).

notes: Any well-argued resolution meets c5 (for example UUIDs generated server-side); a resolution that keeps the silent merge must address its security risk.
